name: stack-layers
title: Stack layers
description: Your architecture as horizontal layers, edge to storage: each with its technologies, a one-line promise and a metric, along a rail that marks a request's path.
docs: Pass layers in the order a request meets them: an id, a name, the technologies as chips, a one-line promise and, if you have one, a metric (a value and what it measures). The block is an ordered list read from top to bottom; the metric is plain text, and the rail on the left is decoration that marks the path of a request. On a wide block the layers are bands separated by hairlines; on a narrow one each becomes a card, joined to the next by a short line. A layer without a metric simply has none. Add a footnote for where the figures come from. Nothing animates, the block has no state and it renders on the server.
